PR references identify related boundaries, not necessarily the introducing change.

### Confirmed gaps

| Gap / related PRs | Concrete scenario and first lost contract | Existing evidence does not cover it |
|---|---|---|
| **Generated token wiring cannot authenticate publishing** — #138, #139, #143, #163 | Fresh runner; user sets the generated npm/PyPI secrets but has no independently configured auth or trusted publishing. Both templates emit `NPM_TOKEN` and `PYPI_TOKEN` at [graph/init.rs:1078](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:1078). Neither template translates these into npm configuration or Twine credentials. Publishing delegates directly to ecosystem tools: [registry.rs:392](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/provider/registry.rs:392), [registry_argv.rs:395](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/registry_argv.rs:395). **First loss:** secret name → tool authentication contract. | Generator tests merely assert the variable names exist: [init.rs:1729](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:1729). Real registry tests separately supply [.npmrc:306](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_real_registry_e2e_tests.rs:306) and [Twine credentials:524](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_real_registry_e2e_tests.rs:524). Docs themselves describe the missing setup: [publishing.md:19](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/docs/publishing.md:19), [publishing.md:75](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/docs/publishing.md:75). |
| **Init offers npm/Python executable artifacts that matrix cannot build** — #138, #139, #163 | An npm `bin` or Python `[project.scripts]` package is selected with an artifact target and `--workflow`. CLI accepts any detected binary package: [CLI/init.rs:336](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/init.rs:336); config emits artifact slots: [graph/init.rs:394](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:394). Matrix then filters out every non-Cargo artifact owner: [commands/matrix.rs:62](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/matrix.rs:62). Generated planning fails with “matrix has no entry”: [init.rs:855](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:855). **First loss:** accepted artifact ecosystem → builder/matrix representation. | [Detection test:1235](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:1235) explicitly accepts these packages, but does not carry them through generated planning/building. The explicit maturin rejection does not cover ordinary Python scripts. |
| **Cargo binary discovery and packaging disagree** — #138, #139, #163 | A Cargo package has two explicit `[[bin]]` targets. Discovery retains only the first: [cargo.rs:229](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs:229). Init therefore creates only its named asset, while generated packaging copies **all** metadata binary targets into that archive: [init.rs:926](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:926). A package using only automatic `src/bin/*.rs` targets is instead missed entirely. **First loss:** complete binary-target inventory → `bin_names`. | [cargo.rs:786](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-manifests/src/cargo.rs:786) explicitly blesses first-only discovery. [Scaffolding test:1465](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:1465) exercises supplied facts, not actual multi-binary discovery followed by packaging. |
| **Installer mistakes arbitrary consumer repositories for Callisto source** — #163 | An unrelated root `Cargo.toml` contains `callisto-cli` in a comment or description. The installer chooses `cargo build --locked -p callisto-cli`, even with an explicit install version, and fails if that package does not exist: [install-callisto.sh:143](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh:143). **First loss:** repository ownership → unqualified substring heuristic; requested install version is bypassed. | [Installer tests:23](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_download_extraction_format.sh:23) explicitly use an empty workspace and skip this branch. Callisto’s own checkout satisfies the heuristic legitimately, so self-release does not expose the false positive. |

### Plausible risks

| Risk / related PRs | Trace and counterevidence |
|---|---|
| **Two napi owners can lose file ownership during download/placement** — #111, #139, #144, #146 | Upload containers retain package-specific names, but all `.node` files are merged into one directory at [init.rs:981](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:981), then that same directory is passed to every package at [init.rs:991](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:991). Two addons sharing `napi.binaryName` and target could produce colliding filenames and receive incorrect bytes. **First loss:** owner → downloaded-file namespace. [matrix.rs:696](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs:696) proves distinct container names, not distinct inner filenames or correct placement. Actual pinned napi filename/placement behavior was not executed; collision outcome remains plausible. |
| **Pinned action can install a newer CLI on resolution failure** — #163 | Simple jobs and durable `version-pr` omit explicit `version`: [init.rs:774](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:774), [init.rs:810](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:810). Durable plan/execute explicitly pin their CLI, creating possible producer/consumer version drift. **First loss:** generated known version → optional runtime ref resolution. Successful resolution is tested, but [test:59](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_action_ref_version_resolution.sh:59) explicitly permits unmatched-ref fallback. Drift is conditional; resulting incompatibility is unproven. |

A different artifact owner still gates product forge publication: [derive test:1462](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/derive.rs:1462) (#109/#154).
- **Authority/secrets:** generated publication authority is default-branch merge, explicitly documented at [releasing.md:38](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/docs/releasing.md:38). Registry secrets reach execution, not planning/building. Durable execution disables cancellation at [init.rs:966](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:966). No additional reviewer/Environment gate is warranted.
- **Recovery/checksum differences:** generated workflows deliberately omit self-release recovery/coordinator machinery: [init.rs:1986](/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init.rs:1986). I did not treat #101/#104 self-release features as unstated generator requirements.
